
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(stars)
library(viridisLite)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
# EJ Screen
ejscreen <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb")) 

# filter to California
california <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA") 

# filter to Los Angeles County 
los_angeles <- ejscreen %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))

# Crashes dataset
crashes <- read_csv(here::here("data", "Crashes.csv")) |>  
  as_tibble() |>
  drop_na(POINT_X) |>
  drop_na(POINT_Y) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("POINT_X", "POINT_Y"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE) |> 
  st_transform(crs = st_crs(los_angeles))

# LA Redlining dataset
redlining_la <- sf::st_read(here::here("data", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))
```

```{r}
# Check CRS for each dataset
st_crs(los_angeles)
st_crs(redlining_la)
st_crs(crashes)

# Transform Redlining LA dataset into same CRS as EJScreen dataset
redlining_la <- st_transform(redlining_la, crs = st_crs(los_angeles))

# Boolen check if CRS match between 2 datasets
st_crs(los_angeles) == st_crs(redlining_la)
st_crs(los_angeles) == st_crs(crashes)
```

```{r}
holc_palette <- c(
      "A" = "#1a63e0",
      "B" = "#20e050",
      "C" = "#ffff77",
      "D" = "#e01044",
      "Missing" = "#c8c1c3")
```

```{r}
tm_shape(redlining_la) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "grade",
    title = "HOLC Residential Grade of Perceived Risk",
    palette = holc_palette
  ) +
  tm_title("Historical Redlining in Los Angeles, California") +
  tm_basemap("OpenStreetMap", alpha = 0.6) 
```

Create table summary of HOLC grades and census blocks

```{r}
join_ejscreen_redlining <- st_join(los_angeles, redlining_la)

ejscreen_redlining <- st_drop_geometry(join_ejscreen_redlining)

glimpse(ejscreen_redlining)

# the percent of census black groups that don’t fall within a HOLC grade in your table

ejscreen_redlining_percent <- ejscreen_redlining |>
  mutate(
    grade = ifelse(is.na(grade), "No HOLC Grade", grade)
  ) |>
  count(grade) |>
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100)

gt(ejscreen_redlining_percent)

```

Create at least two visualizations summarizing current conditions (from the EJScreen data) within HOLC grades using the mean of the following variables (you may combine variables in a single visualization or look at a single variable per plot)

Use ggplot for your visualizations! You will first need to calculate mean of each variable grouped by HOLC grade.

```{r}
PM25_grade <- ejscreen_redlining |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  summarise(PM25 = mean(PM25), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(PM25_grade, mapping = aes(x = grade, y = PM25)) +
  geom_col()

life_exp_grade <- ejscreen_redlining |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  summarise(life_exp = mean(LIFEEXPPCT, na.rm = TRUE))

ggplot(life_exp_grade, mapping = aes(x = grade, y = life_exp)) +
  geom_col()

low_income_grade <- ejscreen_redlining |> 
  group_by(grade) |> 
  summarise(low_income = (mean(LOWINCPCT) * 100), na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(low_income_grade, mapping = aes(x = grade, y = low_income)) +
  geom_col()

```

```{r}

# A figure summarizing the percent of observations within redlined neighborhoods within each HOLC grade

# Filter to two columns I want
select_crashes <- crashes |> 
  select(POINT_X, POINT_Y, PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT, BICYCLE_ACCIDENT)

# drop na or change them under a different name?

select_crashes <- select_crashes |> 
  mutate(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT = ifelse(is.na(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT), "No accident", PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT)) |> 
  mutate(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT = ifelse(is.na(BICYCLE_ACCIDENT), "No accident", BICYCLE_ACCIDENT))

# join datasets/ drop geometry

join_crashes_redlining <- st_join(select_crashes, redlining_la) |> 
  st_drop_geometry()

# Percent table

crashes_redlining_percent <- join_crashes_redlining |>
  mutate(
    grade = ifelse(is.na(grade), "No HOLC Grade", grade)
  ) |> 
  filter(PEDESTRIAN_ACCIDENT == "Y" | BICYCLE_ACCIDENT == "Y") |>
  count(grade) |>
  mutate(percent = (n / sum(n)) * 100)

gt(crashes_redlining_percent)

```
